point3_theNewSpelling.whatTheTextMaskerCanOutput: Each run of letters becomes X, x or the Devanagari letter a, unless it is already only X, x, D or that letter, or (under a header that is not personal) a listed safe word, or m, ft, yd or B followed by D. Digits become D. Everything else is copied (packages/server/src/modules/usp/ingestion/column-profile.ts:64-74).
